description: Write the stored credentials into the env file the framework actually reads (default .env.local), add the framework public aliases for public keys only (NEXT_PUBLIC_*/VITE_*, never for a service-role key), refresh a values-free .env.example, and make sure .gitignore covers the env files. Values move file-to-file: the result lists key NAMES, never values.

force.description: Overwrite a key that already has a different value (a timestamped backup is kept)

target.description: Env file name inside the project (default .env.local)

name: env_sync
